# Introduction

::: {#def-category}
## Category
A category is a pair of classes $(\Ob, \Mor)$ and a pair of class functions $\dom, \cod:\Mor\to \Ob$ which satisfy the following axioms.

::: {.axioms}
#. For any two elements $\phi,\psi\in \Mor$ with $\dom \psi =\cod \phi$ there is a unique element $\psi\circ\phi\in \Mor$ such that $\dom (\psi\circ\phi)=\dom \phi$ and $\cod (\psi\circ\phi)=\cod \psi$.
#. For elements $\phi, \psi, \rho\in \Mor$ such that $\psi\circ\phi$ and $\rho\circ \psi$ are well defined we have that
$$\rho\circ (\psi\circ\phi)=(\rho\circ\psi)\circ \phi$$
#.For each $X\in \Ob$ there exists an element $\id_X\in \Mor$ with $\dom \id_X = \cod \id_X=X$ such that for any $\phi,\psi\in \Mor$ with $\dom \psi = \cod \phi= X$ we have
$$\id_X\circ \phi= \phi\quad\text{and}\quad\psi\circ \id_X=\psi$$
:::

:::
